scope: Clarification of the frozen worker memory counters; no post-qualification runtime change.
peak_counter_formula: count8 + write_count8; includes owned mappings/page tables and the separately allocated single-writer buffer
whole_os_accounting: Kernel/desktop fixed reservations, device buffers and framebuffers are separate from the worker page limit and remain part of whole-system accounting. Configured VM RAM is not process consumption.
